Live Well Movement

Strength, movement & mentorship with Tristan

Tristan Brown is a movement coach and mentor whose work is hard to put in a box — part strength training, part stillness, part the conversations a man has when he finally stops outrunning himself. The practice was strong; the way it showed up online was not. We were brought in to design a home for the practice that read like Tristan, and to build the customer journey that would let it scale beyond his calendar.

 

We built a new Webflow site designed around the three ways someone can work with Tristan — the free 5-day challenge, the movement-focused mentorship, and the full 12-session journey. Behind it: a online booking routed into Klaviyo, a 5-Day Embodiment Challenge funnel, a mentorship enquiry flow, and welcome, abandoned-cart and post-purchase email programs. Editorial layout, real photography, language pulled from long-form conversations rather than written for SEO.

Visit the site

Webflow · Klaviyo

Every Field Note is a newsletter and a journal entry at once — written long-form by Tristan, finished in the site by us. Bookings, intake, follow-up and content all route through one Klaviyo, one booking system, one Webflow.
